title: struthanthus suaveolens
intro: Struthanthus suaveolens, commonly known as the Struthanthus vine, is a type of parasitic plant that derives its nutrients from other plants. It has been found to possess various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Struthanthus suaveolens include its antispasmodic and expectorant properties, which help to relax the muscles and promote the elimination of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
